query:
UPDATE tagging_services
               SET config = jsonb_set(
                       CASE WHEN config ? 'rules' THEN config ELSE config || '{"rules":[]}'::jsonb END,
                       '{rules}', COALESCE(config->'rules', '[]'::jsonb) || $3),
                   updated_at = now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc'
               WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2 AND service_type = 'rule'::service_type
